rename.from: Query params containing commas result in a redirect
rename.to: Query params containing commas result in an extra navigation

body: Seems like changing `router.navigateByUrl(url.pathname);` for `router.navigateByUrl(url.pathname + url.search);` fixes the issue

issue.title: fix(router): forward the query parameters in the ng1 -> ng2 url sync

labels.name: action: merge
labels.description: The PR is ready for merge by the caretaker

body:
While query parameters aren't dropped anymore, it looks like they're still not being handled properly.  Now I see a brief flicker in the location bar, which appears to correspond to the URL quickly changing to http://localhost:3000/teams?foo=bar2%2baz, then back to http://localhost:3000/teams?foo=bar,baz.

The browser's back button also doesn't successfully navigate back in the URL history for parameters containing a comma.  To demonstrate this, try the original repro case, but add queryParamsHandling="merge" to the link in team_list.component.html. If you click on a team link, then attempt to use the browser's "back" functionality, the page is not updated.

One addition from me: The `setUpLocationSync` function has another issue - it drops the hash part of the url.
So the fix probably should be `router.navigateByUrl(url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);`

cc @vicb @mhevery @jasonaden @naomiblack
